title: Recidivism Prediction, Peer Effect Estimation, and Prediction-Powered Inference with LLM Text Measures
abstract: arXiv:2509.20634v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We provide a new framework for estimating peer effects when outcomes are multivariate behavioral measures derived from written text using an LLM and the network formation is endogenous. We obtain LLM embeddings and zero shot classification of more than 200,000 written exchanges among residents of low-security correctional facilities. We find that LLM embeddings improve out-of-sample recidivism prediction by up to 30% over pre-entry covariates alone using LASSO and LoRA fine-tuning, showing that text representations capture meaningful signals. For peer effect estimation, we develop a novel instrumental variable estimator that accommodates multivariate outcomes, sparse networks, and multidimensional latent homophily. We show that this estimator is $\sqrt{N}$-consistent and asymptotically normal under sparsity conditions that relax dense-network assumptions prevalent in the peer effect literature. translated_title: 基于LLM文本度量的再犯预测、同伴效应估计与预测驱动推断
translated_abstract: 我们提供了一个新框架，用于在结果是由大语言模型（LLM）从书面文本中提取的多变量行为度量、且网络形成具有内生性时，估计同伴效应。我们对低安全级别惩教机构中在押人员之间超过20万条书面交流进行了LLM嵌入和零样本分类。我们发现，在使用LASSO和LoRA微调的情况下，LLM嵌入相比仅使用入所前协变量，可将样本外再犯预测准确率提高多达30%，这表明文本表示能够捕捉有意义的信号。在同伴效应估计方面，我们开发了一种新颖的工具变量估计器，能够处理多变量结果、稀疏网络和多维潜在同质性。我们证明，在放宽了同伴效应文献中普遍存在的稠密网络假设的稀疏性条件下，该估计器具有√N一致性和渐近正态性。随后，有限的人工标注被结……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个以LLM文本嵌入作为多变量行为结果的新框架，开发了能在稀疏网络和内生网络形成下估计同伴效应的新型工具变量估计器，并结合有限人工标注进行预测驱动推断，其中LLM嵌入将样本外再犯预测准确率提升了多达30%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new framework using LLM text embeddings as multivariate behavioral outcomes, develops a novel instrumental variable estimator for peer effects under sparse networks and endogenous network formation, and combines LLM predictions with limited human annotations via prediction-powered inference, with LLM embeddings improving out-of-sample recidivism prediction by up to 30%.
